name: Hot-pan dinner
intro: One very hot pan: sear the protein, then char corn and peaches in what's left. Ten minutes, and the pan does the cooking.
season_anchor: Sweet corn, cut into short lengths or kernels

variations.context: Steak first, rested while the corn and peaches char. Salsa at the table.
Shrimp for two minutes, then the peaches. Lime over everything.
Basil and a spoonful of vinaigrette over the shrimp and corn.

finish: Heat the pan until it smokes. Sear the protein first and set it aside. Then the corn and peach halves, cut side down, until they char in spots — two or three minutes. Everything goes on one plate with the juices from the resting meat.
